subject: Trading
title: Moving Average Crossovers
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Moving Average Crossovers.

hook.text: When the 50-day average crosses above the 200-day, it's called a 'golden cross.' Traders treat it as a buy signal.

buildup.text: Moving average crossovers detect trend changes by comparing a fast average to a slow one.

discovery.text: The golden cross (50 over 200) is bullish. The death cross (50 under 200) is bearish.

twist.text: Both signals lag—they confirm trends that already started. You'll never catch the exact bottom or top.

climax.text: Crossovers work best in trending markets. In choppy ranges, they produce costly false signals.

punchline.text: Crossovers confirm the trend. They don't predict it.

quiz.question: What is a golden cross?
options: When price hits an all-time high
When the 50-day moving average crosses above the 200-day
